title: VIO to MAVLink bridge with ENU/FLU to NED/FRD conversion
summary: Sends an external pose source (VIO topic or CSV log) to PX4 EKF2 or ArduPilot EKF3 as VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE or ODOMETRY for GPS-denied position hold. The frame conversion (ENU/FLU to NED/FRD, world to body velocity, MAVLink covariance layout) is a stdlib module with unit tests, and the pymavlink sender is a thin sketch on top.
verified: frames.py and test_frames.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 (8 tests OK), and bridge.py --dry-run ran on example_pose_enu.csv; output shown in README. The pymavlink send path and the SITL parameter recipes are an unverified sketch: syntax-checked only, requires pymavlink and a PX4 or ArduPilot SITL.
